fields.value: The project focused on building an intelligent medical claims processing platform for Aviva Insurance, utilizing cutting-edge GenAI technologies to automate and optimize claim workflows. The solution leveraged Vertex AI (Gemini Pro) for natural language understanding, integrated with LangChain, LlamaIndex, and FAISS to implement a robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework. By combining NLP, machine learning, and vector search with structured data access from BigQuery and Firestore, the platform enables accurate interpretation of claim requests, contextual document retrieval from internal policy documents, and real-time decisioning. Built with FastAPI and Python, the backend supports secure API communication, integrates with enterprise claim databases, and applies PII redaction, tool calling, and CSAT evaluation for compliance and user experience optimization.

fields.value: Lloyds Bank Open Banking is a financial initiative that embraces digital innovation to provide customers with enhanced financial services. Through Open Banking, Lloyds allows customers to securely share their financial data with authorized third-party providers, enabling a more interconnected and personalized banking experience. This initiative leverages Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) to facilitate seamless communication between Lloyds Bank and external financial applications, fostering the development of innovative financial products and services. Customers can benefit from a broader range of financial insights, budgeting tools, and tailored offerings, as Open Banking enables the secure sharing of financial information between Lloyds Bank and trusted third-party applications. The initiative aligns with the broader industry trend towards increased transparency, competition, and customer empowerment in the financial sector. Lloyds Bank Open Banking aims to enhance customer experiences, promote financial inclusion, and foster a more dynamic and competitive financial ecosystem.

fields.value: Cynergy bank is embarking on a banking transformation program with the principle of Human centric and experience led Service Design of customer & colleague journeys. The Cynergy Connect™ Banking Platform will be delivered iteratively through multiple transitions or Outcomes. Cynergy Connect technology stack conforms to a multi-layered model, with Integration Service Plane, Business Service Plane, Data Service Plane and Service Management Plane as the main building blocks. Data Services acts as the master plane of information, which is at the heart of a digital organization. Information feeds into the business services to create a single consistent view of both the customer and the organization. This brings together operational and analytical dimensions into a single consistent view of information.
